spans.s: अचोदनम् [acōdanam], Non-injunction, a more statement (of something already known); देशकालानामचोदनं प्रयोगे नित्य- समवायात्
अचोदस् [acōdas], a. Ved. [नास्ति चोदना यस्य] Spontaneous, not influenced by external force or compulsion. अचोदसो न धन्वन्त्विन्दवः
अचोविनः [acōvinḥ], (?) Probably a special messenger to report among other things, impending attacks from enemies; Sircar,
